name: Apostle Yuki
source:
Yuki is the apostle of the ice angel Dark Lord [url=/c93217]La Saizel[/url], and as such is also a member of the Kayblis Faction. As she was previously a Frozen Gal Monster, she has powerful ice powers to better supplement those of her master. However as an apostle, instead of showing the usual deference to her Dark Lord, she is extremely insolent and often openly mocks her superior. Despite this, she is quite loyal when the chips are down and will not hesitate to kill any who would threaten the ice angel. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Yuki]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
